| # Define a look up table for temperature sensors {#define-a-look-up-table-for-temperature-sensors-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"} |                                                                                                                                                              |
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

The BSW supports the following temperature sensors:

 

- TSF (sensor type is PTC)

- TSA (sensor type is PTC)

- TFW (sensor type is NTC)

 

For every sensor a look up table with the corresponding resistance values is defined, see also  bds_in_ri_cfgTemp.

 

For additional sensors the corresponding look up tables are necessary, see examples below.

 

Restrictions:

- The array shall be defined as uint16.

- The array size shall be 256.

- The possible measurement range is -50..205°C with a resolution of 1°C.

 

 

 

 

VAR_GLOBAL CONSTANT
